"''My sisters.|Mon Mothma and Tay Kolma, to Leida Mothma|audio=Mothma-Kolma-Sisters.flac|}} '''Marsa''' was the [[Gender|sister]] of [[Adrine]] and the [[Chandrilan]] [[human]] [[Tay Kolma]], a member of the [[Bank of Kolma|Bank Of Kolma]]. They at one point made the acquaintance of [[Leida Mothma]], the daughter of Chandrilan [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], on the [[Mothma family|Mothmas']] [[homeworld]], [[Chandrila]]. When Leida later encountered Kolma on the [[planet]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Coruscant]] in [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|107}} Mon reminded her daughter that she already knew Kolma and his sisters; however, Leida was not sure that she remembered them. ==Behind the scenes== Marsa was mentioned in "[[Announcement]]," the seventh episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[October 19]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
